## Meaning of support

Allowed means an intended review candidate in `ecosystems.json`, not verified compatibility with every host/model. Skipped means no approved candidate placement. Shipped platform sources remain independently maintained. File existence and deterministic generation verify repository structure only, not installation or native behavior.

Declarations: [`master-skills/github-readme/ecosystems.json`](https://github.com/mickpletcher/AI-Skills/blob/main/master-skills/github-readme/ecosystems.json); capabilities: [`master-skills/github-readme/capabilities.json`](https://github.com/mickpletcher/AI-Skills/blob/main/master-skills/github-readme/capabilities.json).

## Verified evidence versus intended support

Recorded bounded native outcome: Fresh repaired original-task README draft passes; actual 2370-byte Copy ends with License and separate notes. Historical intake preserved; current Codex file integration passes separately.

Acceptance: Accepted by Mick-authorized agent within recorded supplied-draft/intake scope; no personal human inspection. This is not whole-skill or cross-ecosystem certification.

Evidence: [`evaluations/fixtures/native-batch11.json`](https://github.com/mickpletcher/AI-Skills/blob/main/evaluations/fixtures/native-batch11.json), [`evaluations/fixtures/readme-delivery22.json`](https://github.com/mickpletcher/AI-Skills/blob/main/evaluations/fixtures/readme-delivery22.json).

Remaining skill-specific limits: Actual README installation/execution not certified; One fresh native draft and one disposable Codex file repair only; broader README modes, packaging, installed launchers and repeatability remain unverified.

Historical Codex host observation: `BOUNDED_LOAD_OBSERVED`. One isolated repository catalog/model; no global routing, full behavior or human acceptance certification. Evidence: [`evaluations/fixtures/host-routing-integration18.json`](https://github.com/mickpletcher/AI-Skills/blob/main/evaluations/fixtures/host-routing-integration18.json).

See [`evaluations/native-coverage-2026-10-22.json`](https://github.com/mickpletcher/AI-Skills/blob/main/evaluations/native-coverage-2026-10-22.json) and [`evaluations/native-coverage-2026-10-22.md`](https://github.com/mickpletcher/AI-Skills/blob/main/evaluations/native-coverage-2026-10-22.md) for exact scopes, revisions and host/model limits. Historical results do not certify current bytes or every ecosystem row. Consult any master `model-history.json` for additional recorded runs. No blanket native verification is claimed for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor or Copilot.

## Capability and runtime limitations

- Required: `text_reasoning`.
- Conditional `web_retrieval`: Required only for current external facts; request supplied sources or label current claims unverified when unavailable.
- Conditional `file_access`: Required for verifying actual local repository contents or saving README changes. Not required for drafting or repairing from pasted source, file listings and README text. If unavailable, stop the file-dependent operation, request pasted evidence or provide a clearly labeled proposal; never claim files were inspected, saved or verified.
- Fallback: If a required capability is unknown or unavailable, stop the dependent operation, identify missing evidence, and request input or offer manual steps. Do not claim completion.
- Safeguards: Capability declarations never grant authorization. Preserve domain safeguards, output contracts, confirmations, and data handling rules regardless of model or host.

Helpers require actual dependencies, permissions and runtime access. See [`docs/installation.md`](https://github.com/mickpletcher/AI-Skills/blob/main/docs/installation.md) and [`docs/dependencies.md`](https://github.com/mickpletcher/AI-Skills/blob/main/docs/dependencies.md).

## When this master changes

1. Review source, resources, capability/ecosystem declarations and adapters above. Do not widen support just because a model can read Markdown.
2. Run `python tools/skill_compatibility.py`, then `python tools/generate_master_skills.py`. Synchronize all listed candidate entry points, supporting resources and provenance. For a newly allowed target, first generate its candidate, refresh this map, then regenerate candidates again.
3. Review each listed existing platform source for an explicitly approved equivalent change. Do not overwrite shipped variants or promote/rebuild their packages automatically from a master update. Review named-model builds separately; profiles cannot widen the allowlist.
4. Run `python tools/skill_compatibility.py --check`, `python tools/generate_master_skills.py --check`, `python tools/skill_repository.py validate` and `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -v`. Record actual host/model tests separately before claiming runtime compatibility.
